name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acromegaly_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.

name: patient_has_been_treated_with_somatostatin_analogue_therapy_in_the_past
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been treated with somatostatin analogue therapy in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever received somatostatin analogue therapy at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never received somatostatin analogue therapy at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever received somatostatin analogue therapy in the past.

name: patient_is_in_treatment_control_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently in treatment control.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently in treatment control.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not in treatment control.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently in treatment control.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_growth_hormone_receptor_antagonist_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently exposed to a growth hormone receptor antagonist.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with (i.e., is currently exposed to) a growth hormone receptor antagonist.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently being treated with (i.e., is not currently exposed to) a growth hormone receptor antagonist.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently being treated with a growth hormone receptor antagonist.

name: patient_has_received_treatment_for_acromegaly_ever
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever received any treatment for acromegaly in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever received any treatment for acromegaly at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never received any treatment for acromegaly at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever received any treatment for acromegaly.

name: patient_has_finding_of_acromegaly_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of acromegaly.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of acromegaly at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of acromegaly at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of acromegaly.

name: patient_has_finding_of_acromegaly_inthehistory@@never_received_any_treatment
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient with a history of acromegaly has never received any treatment for it at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a history of acromegaly and has never received any treatment for acromegaly at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has a history of acromegaly and has received any treatment for acromegaly at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has never received any treatment for acromegaly.
